beats.text: This is our new series, ML for a Java developer. I'm Kali, a software engineer with 13+ years of experience, and I am learning ML through Java eyes. This series is for every Java developer who is curious about machine learning and wants to see how it works, visually. But first, why should a Java developer learn ML at all?
